# Earlier logarithmic tubular study

`log_400x400_partial.zip` preserves the numerical files, producer manifests,
literature inputs and drivers present at the start of the 1000 × 500 revision
(HEAD `7df87d4bc00a62b3220426ebe5bfa23bb05326ee`, with the preceding Gaussian/PNG
changes uncommitted). Every archived file was checked against its starting SHA256.

The 400 × 400 calculation completed, but its required same-mesh time-refinement
dataset was missing. It is a historical partial study, not the active reference.
The literature readings remain unchanged in `paper/precipitation/data/literature/`.
